ud7.2:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud7.2:1.3: atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantaṃ Lakuṇṭhakabhaddiyaṃ sekho 'ti maññamāno bhiyyosomattāya anekapariyāyena dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
ud7.2:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ āyasmantaṃ Lakuṇṭhakabhaddiyaṃ sekho 'ti maññamāno bhiyyosomattāya anekapariyāyena dhammiyā kathāya sandassentaṃ samādapentaṃ samuttejentaṃ sampahaṃsentaṃ.
ud7.2:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
